en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 291 - It is narrated from Ja’far bin Muhammad from Muhammad bin Husain bin Abil Khattab from Muhammad bin Ismail bin Yazid from Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman Asim from Abdur Rahman bin Siyabah from Imran bin Mitham from Abaya bin Rabi Asadi that he said:
I heard Amirul Momineen (a.s) say: “How would you be when you are left without an Imam of guidance or a visible standard, when some of you turn away from the other with disdain?”
